# NaCl (B2): EOS reconstruction reports

<!-- Generated by scripts.generate_reconstruction_reports; edit EOSMAT instead. -->

[All reconstruction reports](index.md) · [Material and EOS parameters](../material-summaries/nacl_b2.md) · [EOSMAT record file](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/materials/nacl_b2.eosmat) · [Audit sidecar](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/audits/nacl_b2.audit.json)

Each section opens with the record's reproduction headline and any usage
warning ([label definitions](../eos-labels.md)), then the scope and basis of
the stored check. Only recorded content is shown: missing selections, weights,
errors or conventions are unknown, not zero, and are not inferred. Generating
this page fits nothing and changes no classification or source coefficient.
Every record is also listed by identifier in the
[numerical ledger](../primary-eos-refits.md#records), its
[machine-readable form](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/docs/data/primary-eos-refits.json) and the
[source-audit reports](../source-audits.md).

**Curves and residuals** replay the full stored source and reconstructed
coefficients on the same recorded audit inputs. Residual = model − input in
the fitted quantity's native units; for pressure, P(model) − P(input) at each
input volume and temperature (isothermal records use their reference
temperature). RMS is an unweighted descriptive error, not a parameter
uncertainty or the weighted fitting objective. With more than five
temperatures, the minimum, middle and maximum isotherms are drawn; residuals
include every selected row. Error bars appear only where all widths are
recoverable and keep the source meaning, including digitization widths.
No uncertainty band is inferred.

**Coefficient graphs** show stored central values and recorded error widths
in the audit's units; each panel includes zero. They are not observation or
residual plots. Fixed/adopted values are constraints, not recovered values.
Tables round an error to two significant digits when its leading digit is 1
or 2, otherwise one, and the value to the error's decimal place; values
without a positive error show at most six significant digits. Full precision
stays in EOSMAT and the ledger.

<a id="record-nacl_b2_shen_2026_vinet_2"></a>

## Shen and Smith (2026), NaCl-B2 Cu-referenced Vinet

**disagrees** · `nacl_b2_shen_2026_vinet_2` · `Vinet` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/nacl_b2.md#record-nacl_b2_shen_2026_vinet_2)

**Warning:** Not recommended for quantitative use. Explicit selection only; not loaded by default.

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** Direct reconstruction from source observations: each Table S1 phase volume is paired with its simultaneous Cu volume, pressure is evaluated from Fratanduono et al.'s analytic third-order 298 K Vinet fit, and K0 and K0\_prime are fitted with Shen and Smith's fixed V0 and stated run selection. The source publishes no pressure weights, residual covariance, or weighting protocol, so the reproduction uses unweighted pressure residuals and does not infer any of them. The paper identifies Table II as direct fits to this study's Cu-referenced P-V data, with earlier literature included for comparison. Its data-availability statement also mentions other author-held data, so completeness of the actual author fit inputs is unconfirmed. No additional experimental fit rows are identified by the published fitting description. See the \[source-input audit\](literature-reproductions/shen-smith-2026-cu-refits.md). Not recommended for scientific predictions or pressure calibration. Retained only for explicit diagnostic inspection. The published fixed-V0 NaCl-B2 Vinet curve gives 0.622381 GPa pressure RMS and mean residual -0.547610 GPa on 125 DAC-2 Table S1 observations above 35 GPa; all 125 residuals are negative. A direct unweighted refit gives K0=25.447259 GPa, K0\_prime=5.582768 and RMS 0.293229 GPa, versus published 24.92 GPa and 5.63. The source-fit discrepancy is unresolved; including the above-33-GPa transition rows does not restore agreement.

**Source review:** `not_reproduced`.

- Not recommended for scientific predictions or pressure calibration. Retained only for explicit diagnostic inspection. The published fixed-V0 NaCl-B2 Vinet curve gives 0.622381 GPa pressure RMS and mean residual -0.547610 GPa on 125 DAC-2 Table S1 observations above 35 GPa; all 125 residuals are negative. A direct unweighted refit gives K0=25.447259 GPa, K0\_prime=5.582768 and RMS 0.293229 GPa, versus published 24.92 GPa and 5.63. The source-fit discrepancy is unresolved; including the above-33-GPa transition rows does not restore agreement.
- Usage recommendation: not\_recommended\_for\_quantitative\_use
- Exact author-used P-V fit table and row mask, pressure-reduction implementation, residual coordinate, weights and covariance are unavailable.
- The article describes Table II as direct fits to this study's Cu-referenced data, with literature parameters for comparison, but its data-availability statement mentions additional author-held data. No extra fit observations are explicitly identified; completeness of the actual author inputs is unconfirmed.

## Peritheos refit: Fei (2007) NaCl-B2 digitized cold + 1000 K data

**reproduced** · `nacl_b2_fei_2007_staged_thermal_refit` · `Vinet` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/nacl_b2.md#record-nacl_b2_fei_2007_staged_thermal_refit)

**Scope:** Reproduction of a stored independent Peritheos refit. **Basis:** Reproduction of the registered Peritheos refit's stored coefficients under its declared protocol.

- This comparison concerns the stored independent Peritheos refit, not recovery of the original publication's coefficients or author workflow.
- Independent Peritheos staged refit of digitized Fei (2007) NaCl-B2 study markers: 12 Figure 3 rows at 300 K determine K0/K0-prime with V0 fixed; then all 12 Figure 4 rows at 1000 K determine q with the cold fit frozen. The printed variable-exponent Debye law, V0, gamma0 and theta0 are inherited from the published record. Equal pressure weights are an analyst choice. Duplicate Figure 4 cold markers, other-paper comparisons and calculated curve vertices are excluded. This is a conditional figure-data refit, not reproduction of the authors' fit or independent validation of pressure accuracy. Original unrounded measurements, P/V/T errors, measured Pt cells, source weights and calibration covariance remain unavailable. Conditional stage errors are archived in fit statistics only; catalog parameter errors and covariance are unset because predictor, calibrant, fixed-anchor and inter-stage uncertainty are not propagated. Coverage consists of separate 300 and 1000 K series, not a validated P-T rectangle.
- Original publication reproduction status: not\_reproduced

The source/target values below are the stored **Peritheos refit**. Agreement with it does not reproduce the original publication's coefficients.

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** nacl\_b2\_fei\_2007\_figure3\_digitized; nacl\_b2\_fei\_2007\_figure4\_digitized
- **Observations:** 24
- **Fit kind:** stored\_staged\_thermal\_refit\_reproduction
- **Objective:** At each stage minimize sum((P\_model(V,T)-P\_digitized)^2) in GPa^2 with equal pressure-residual weights; cold K0/K0\_prime first, then hot q with the cold fit frozen.
- **Free parameters:** K0; K0\_prime; q
- **Fixed parameters:** V0; gamma0; theta0; n; Tr
